  "claims": [

      "claim": "Plato introduced the term idea into philosophic terminology, as testified by Aristotle in his Metaphysics.",

      "claim": "There are labor songs but no work songs, and the songs of craftsmen are social and sung after work.",
      "claim_type": "scholarly_interpretation",
      "supporting_excerpt": "One of the best of these studies (Joseph Schopp, Das deutsche Arbeitslied [1935]) stresses that there exist only labor songs, but no work songs. The songs of the craftsmen are social; they are sung after work.",
      "support_kind": "direct",
      "confidence": 1
    }
